comment: People who are in view all afternoon and should never be counted. Each host is learned from the crops that best match its description; check output/review/seeds_*.jpg and host_*.jpg. min_prob is how sure the classifier must be to tag someone as a host: raise it if visitors show up in host_*.jpg, lower it if a host shows up in near_*.jpg. fill_prob is the lower bar used when a host was seen seconds before and after.
